items.headline: OpenAI unveils GPT-6 and Intelligent UI
items.summary: OpenAI announced GPT-6 alongside a new 'Intelligent UI' aimed at making advanced AI accessible to everyone. The release marks the company's latest push to broaden mainstream adoption of its frontier models.

items.headline: Stanford AI Index 2026 shows narrowing model gap
items.summary: The 2026 AI Index reports that Anthropic's top model now leads benchmarks by just 2.7%, signaling intensifying competition at the frontier. The data-driven report offers one of the most comprehensive views of the AI landscape as of March 2026.

items.headline: AI dominates week's largest US startup funding rounds
items.summary: This week's biggest US venture financings were led almost entirely by AI companies, including a $1 billion round topping the list. The concentration underscores continued investor appetite for AI despite broader market caution.
